home.headline: I'm a UX leader with a background in research, design systems, and digital accessibility.
home.introduction: Hi, I’m Carl. I bring more than 20 years of experience in design, including public services and the tools behind them.
home.who: I'm a UX manager, researcher, and design systems engineer. I've collaborated with government agencies, international nonprofits, educational organizations, and intergovernmental organizations.
home.what: I connect UX research with inclusive design and working code. I’ve managed and mentored designers, aligned stakeholders around a shared strategy, and built inclusive design systems.
home.panelHeading: I turn complex workflows into accessible interfaces.
